name: Find The Colas [201]
desc:
✨ Welcome to Find The Colas! Search and find hidden colas through multiple biomes. Can you collect them all?

Update (November 6th):
-Added 39 new colas!
-New biomes and hiding spots
-Cool new minigames!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the map to find all of the colas
🏃 Use sprint to complete obbies easier
🧩 Discover cool hiding spots and minigames
🏆 Find all colas to win!

Some colas are very easy to find and some are well hidden. 

💫 201 Colas

If you want to suggest NEW colas, post a message on the group wall.
